parameters.name: CompanyLimitCount
parameters.description: The restriction count for company devices.

parameters.name: CompanyLimitType
parameters.description:
The restriction type for company devices. Valid values:

- **Unlimited**: No restrictions.

- **LimitAll**: Limit by total count.

- **LimitDiff**: Limit by device category.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: A description of the device registration policy. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

parameters.name: MatchMode
parameters.description:
The target type for policy matching. Valid values:

- **UserGroupAll**: Apply to all users.

- **UserGroupNormal**: Apply to selected user groups.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the device registration policy. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PersonalLimitCount
parameters.description: The restriction count for personal devices.

parameters.name: PersonalLimitType
parameters.description:
The restriction type for personal devices. Valid values:

- **Unlimited**: No restrictions.

- **LimitAll**: Limit by total count.

- **LimitDiff**: Limit by device category.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The priority of the device registration policy. A value of 0 indicates the highest priority. A value of 99 indicates the lowest priority.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the device registration policy. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: UserGroupIds
parameters.description: The IDs of user groups to which the device registration policy applies. Required if MatchMode is set to **UserGroupNormal**. A maximum of 100 user groups can be specified per policy.

parameters.name: Whitelist
parameters.description: The list of usernames in the whitelist for the device registration policy. You can specify up to 1,000 usernames.
